bounded_scope: Contemporary standard written English used for Pointfire research and public explanation; dialectal, conversational and literary varieties require added annotation.
nonessentialist_limit: Describes bounded grammatical requirements and discourse resources, not every English speaker, region, genre or cognitive style.

ordinary_discourse: finite subject realization, tense-aspect, reference and explicit clause linkage in standard expository use
literary_calibration: plural English literary possibilities retained as a human gate; no author profile or cloning model

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Finite declaratives strongly require a grammatical subject; passive, cleft and fronting organize focus.
transformation_risks: source topic converted into an invented real-world actor
counterexamples_and_variation: imperatives, diary style, headlines and dialogue allow omission

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Voice and argument structure often make agency overt, but agentless passive and change-of-state forms remain ordinary.
transformation_risks: agent added to Mandarin agentless event
counterexamples_and_variation: task and discourse affect agent mention

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Finite clauses select tense; progressive, perfect and lexical aspect jointly organize contour and endpoint.
transformation_risks: target tense treated as source endpoint evidence
counterexamples_and_variation: narrative present and nonfinite clauses alter temporal expression

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Modals, adverbs, reporting verbs and source phrases mark evidential and epistemic stance; evidential morphology is generally not obligatory.
counterexamples_and_variation: source can be tracked in citation outside the sentence

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Standard finite clauses normally require overt subjects, while coordination, nonfinite clauses, imperatives and discourse ellipsis license omission.
transformation_risks: forced referent for Mandarin or Japanese zero argument
counterexamples_and_variation: informal and literary English permit wider omission

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Subordination and explicit connectives are productive, while juxtaposition remains lawful.
transformation_risks: connective invented to satisfy target cohesion
counterexamples_and_variation: literary and conversational English can be highly paratactic

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Verbs frequently foreground manner with satellite-like path expressions, but alternatives are abundant.
counterexamples_and_variation: lexicon, genre and event type change realization

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Subject position, passive, clefts, there-constructions and prosody manage given/new order.
transformation_risks: Mandarin event-first order nested under an abstract subject
counterexamples_and_variation: rhetorical inversion and genre vary order

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Address, modal hedging, titles and register encode stance; grammaticalized honorific paradigms are limited.
Articles, number, derivation and lexical choice force granularity decisions beyond source form.
transformation_risks: specificity or number imposed on underspecified source
counterexamples_and_variation: mass nouns, generic uses and specialist vocabulary complicate mapping

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Subordinate periods, coordination, dashes, semicolons and paragraphing can all organize breathing.
counterexamples_and_variation: long sentences are not inherently translated; short sentences are not inherently clear

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Academic nominalization, news compression, informal ellipsis and literary markedness are lawful register resources.
counterexamples_and_variation: register and discipline govern acceptable density

inbound_outbound_summary: Chinese-to-English: every added subject, article, tense and connective must be audited as a framing choice.
English-to-Chinese: target prose should be organized through Chinese topic, event and information-order resources rather than word substitution.
Nominalization and passive voice are resources, not automatic defects; agency and claim effects decide.
